delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete it?
delete.shared: It's shared: other people won't be able to access it in {{gameName}}.
delete.warning_one: This will delete “{{title}}” from {{gameName}}: its {{count}} page and extracted text. The game's explanation will be regenerated from the remaining rulebooks.

reprocess.description: We'll read every page again with OCR and re-index the text. The game's explanation will be regenerated.

save.description: This will replace what was read on page {{pageNumber}}: the AI will answer with your version, and the page will be marked as “Edited by hand”.

load.description: It may have been deleted or could still be processing. Go back to your library and try again from there.
load.title: We couldn't open this rulebook

edit.busyHint: Hang on until it finishes, then try again.
edit.pendingIndexDescription: Your text is saved. Reprocess the rulebook to sync the AI.
edit.savedDescription: The AI will use your version from now on.

image.missingDescription: This page may still be processing or may not have a saved render yet.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.tip: This page is identical to another you already uploaded. It won't be read again because it doesn't add anything new, so this copy won't count toward the explanation.

edited.label: Edited by hand
edited.tip: You corrected this page by hand.

failed.label: Reading error
failed.tip: We couldn't extract text from this page. Try again or upload another photo.

low.label: Needs review
low.tip: The OCR isn't sure about this page. You can read it again or correct it by hand.

ok.label: Scanned successfully
ok.tip: The OCR recognized this page's text with good quality.

processing.label: Processing
processing.tip: This page is still in the reading queue.

text.edited: You corrected this page by hand · the text no longer comes from OCR.
